figure_caption: Cold-start protocol. A history matrix with missing cells is given to the method; it commits to $k$ benchmark indices; only the new model's scores on those $k$ benchmarks are revealed; the method predicts all other benchmarks; error is measured in units of history column standard deviations and compared with column-mean, random-$k$ ridge and greedy-forward ridge baselines and with permuted-observation controls.

panels.title: Cold-start protocol and scoring
panels.short_caption: Commit to k benchmarks, reveal only those, impute the rest, and score the unselected cells against baselines and controls.
panels.drawio_prompt:
SINGLE IDEA: a cold-start episode runs left to right: the method sees only a history matrix, commits to k benchmarks, receives only those scores for a family-disjoint new model, imputes the rest, and is scored on the remaining observed cells against evaluator-owned baselines and controls.

NODES (stable IDs):
- hist: DATA, sharp-cornered grid (matrix) titled 'History matrix' with rows = models, columns = benchmarks; some cells empty/hatched to show missing cells; axis tags 'models' and 'benchmarks'. Highlight is not needed on specific cells.
- split: small DATA tag attached below hist: 'Family-disjoint split' linking hist and held (a thin divider/bracket between a history block and a held-out block; no model family on both sides).
- held: DATA, a single-row strip (one new model) titled 'Held-out model', with one cell per benchmark column aligned to hist's columns; all cells initially hidden/greyed (scores unseen).
- method: PROCESS, rounded box titled 'Selector–imputer pair' (trained on history only; fitted component). Two small stacked sub-labels inside: 'Selector' and 'Imputer'.
- commit: RESULT/DECISION, small rounded chip 'Commit: set S of k benchmarks' placed on the edge between selector and the held-out strip; a lock glyph signals the commitment is made before any new-model score is seen.
- reveal: DATA, the same held-out strip as held but now with ONLY the k selected columns revealed (filled), others still hidden; titled 'Revealed: $$y_{iS}$$'. Draw it as a second copy of the strip to the right of the commit chip.
- impute: PROCESS, rounded box 'Impute remaining benchmarks' producing the strip pred.
- pred: DATA, the strip with all non-selected cells filled as predictions, titled '$$\hat{y}_{ij}$$' (predicted).
- truth: DATA, small strip 'True held-out scores' on the unselected observed cells $$\mathcal{C}_i$$ (cells observed for the model but not in S).
- score: PROCESS, rounded box 'nRMSE' with sub-label 'error in units of $$\sigma_j$$' (history column std). Takes pred and truth as inputs. This is the central scoring node.
- skill: RESULT, small box 'Skill vs baseline' with sub-label '1 − nRMSE / nRMSE_b'. Do NOT render a full equation.
- baselines: stacked group of three DATA/PROCESS boxes titled 'Evaluator-owned baselines': 'Column mean', 'Random-$$k$$ ridge', 'Greedy-forward ridge'. These are NOT trainable by the method (mark as frozen/external, e.g. with a small lock tag 'evaluator-owned').
- controls: group titled 'Negative controls' with two boxes: 'Permuted observations' and 'Constant (column-mean) observations'. They feed a tampered version of the reveal strip.
- agg: small PROCESS box at far right 'Aggregate: seeds → k grid → leaderboards'.

EDGES (source → target; solid = forward data flow, dashed = auxiliary / comparison):
1. hist → method (solid, label 'history only').
2. hist → split → held (thin solid/bracket, no label; shows disjoint held-out models).
3. method → commit (solid, label 'selects').
4. commit → held (solid, label '$$S$$') indicating which columns get revealed; then held → reveal (solid, label 'reveal $$k$$ scores').
5. reveal → impute (solid, label '$$y_{iS}$$').
6. method → impute (dashed, label 'fitted imputer').
7. impute → pred (solid).
8. pred → score (solid) and truth → score (solid).
9. score → skill (solid).
10. baselines → skill (dashed, label 'nRMSE$$_b$$' — each baseline also predicts the same unselected cells; baselines enter the skill comparison).
11. controls → impute (dashed, label 'swap in controlled observations') — the controls replace the revealed strip before imputation; draw as a branch from reveal through controls into impute.
12. skill → agg (solid).

SPATIAL LAYOUT (wide 21:9, left to right in three zones):
- LEFT zone (~25% width): hist at top-left with split + held directly beneath it; method to the right of hist.
- MIDDLE zone (~40%): commit chip → reveal strip → impute → pred in a horizontal row aligned with held's row; controls group sits just below/above the reveal→impute edge.
- RIGHT zone (~35%): truth and pred both feed score; score → skill → agg left to right; baselines stacked above/below skill with dashed edges in.
Keep a clear horizontal baseline; avoid edge crossings except the single controls branch.
A subtle zone header text above each zone: 'Given', 'Cold-start episode', 'Scored'.

IMPORTANCE RANKING: (1) commit chip + reveal strip (the committed-before-seeing constraint), (2) score box 'nRMSE' and the unselected cells it covers, (3) hist and method, (4) baselines and controls, (5) agg and split tags.

TEXT BUDGET (exact labels only): 'History matrix', 'models', 'benchmarks', 'Family-disjoint split', 'Held-out model', 'Selector–imputer pair', 'Selector', 'Imputer', 'Commit: set S of k benchmarks', 'Revealed: $$y_{iS}$$', 'Impute remaining benchmarks', '$$\hat{y}_{ij}$$', 'True held-out scores', 'nRMSE', 'error in units of $$\sigma_j$$', 'Skill vs baseline', 'Evaluator-owned baselines', 'Column mean', 'Random-$$k$$ ridge', 'Greedy-forward ridge', 'Negative controls', 'Permuted observations', 'Constant observations', 'Aggregate: seeds → k grid → leaderboards', 'Given', 'Cold-start episode', 'Scored', plus edge labels listed above. No sentences. No results numbers.
